Maya Chen: quick sync — North Ridge renewal talk. We need a concise ask pack for leadership: top risk, mitigation, and a single requested action from execs.
Devon Patel: I can assemble the pack. Want it to be one slide + talking notes. What is the single top ask we want? :question:
Karla Nguyen: top technical blocker remains SSO cert approval and test keys. Those two are gating go-live for onboarding customers.
Priya Rao: pulled a couple of recent support quotes: "can't complete onboarding without SSO" and "stuck on test creds for days" — will anonymize and paste into the pack.
Samir Ortiz: usage telemetry shows a 12% drop in week-over-week API calls after the last rollout; revenue flagged renewal probability down to ~65%. I'll add a chart.
Maya Chen: executive ask should be: fast-track SSO approval or agree to a temporary manual onboarding SLA for affected customers. Both are acceptable asks; prefer the former.
Devon Patel: slide ownership plan: one-pager (me), onboarding ops + quotes (Karla/ Priya), telemetry & cost impact (Samir), exec ask wording + fallback (Maya).
Karla Nguyen: on onboarding ops slide: will show blocked items, owners, dates, and the mitigation steps engineering can run (quick runbook snippet).
Priya Rao: adding 2 anonymized customer snippets and a short NPS note.
Samir Ortiz: for telemetry, I'll include: 7-day avg calls, peak concurrency, and a simple annotation: \"post-rollout latency spike -> partial client retries -> drop in session starts\". Also include a one-line cost impact estimate.
Maya Chen: timeline: draft pack by Mon 18:00 UTC, internal review Tue 09:00 PT, exec review Tue 16:00 PT. Everyone ok? :calendar:
Devon Patel: yes. I'll try to have a first draft by Mon 15:00 UTC to get early feedback.
Karla Nguyen: I'll upload onboarding runbook snippet and blocked task list by Mon 17:00 UTC.
Priya Rao: customer quotes ready by Mon 16:30 UTC.
Samir Ortiz: telemetry visuals done by Mon 18:00 UTC.
Maya Chen: contingency to include: if SSO unresolved by Wed AM -> offer a one-time credit + assign a dedicated SRE to accelerate test keys. Put projected cost of credit on the risks slide.
Devon Patel: noted. I'll add a small decision tree graphic: \"SSO green -> normal; SSO delayed -> credit + manual onboarding\".
Karla Nguyen: engineering mitigation: temporary bypass of KV cache warmup for onboarding traffic as a short-term fix. I'll include the command snippet: `./deploy --skip-kv-warmup` and a 4-step checklist.
Priya Rao: will anonymize quotes and include timestamps from support ticket thread #45298.
